reason_for_new_version: The preserved July-2026 STRICT_ACTUAL_RELEASE Fiscal baseline cannot be reproduced without guesswork because the exact historical release-time runner/vintages were not recovered. Candidate 1 is therefore an explicit new version rather than a silent legacy reconstruction.
score_availability_rule: Fiscal observation month t becomes eligible at calendar month-end t+1 after the monthly Treasury balance release; GDP uses only a quarter whose conservative availability date is quarter-start plus three calendar months, month-end.

scoring_sources.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis / FRED
scoring_sources.units_contract: millions of USD; negative values are deficits
scoring_sources.availability_rule: observation month t available at calendar month-end t+1

scoring_sources.source: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis via FRED
scoring_sources.units_contract: billions of USD, seasonally adjusted annual rate
scoring_sources.availability_rule: quarter-start q available at calendar month-end q+3

transforms.deficit_pct_gdp: 100 * ttm_deficit_billions / latest GDP eligible under the frozen GDP availability rule
transforms.supportive_direction: higher deficit_pct_gdp and higher fiscal_impulse_pp are more supportive fiscal impulse for this overlay

standardization.method: rolling z-score computed only from observations available up to each signal month
standardization.signed_direction: positive z means more fiscally supportive

aggregation.economic_rule: The score rewards both a large current fiscal injection and acceleration in that injection. Equal weighting is frozen to prevent parameter search and avoids adding multiple highly collinear fiscal-flow measures.

fixed_initial_gates.legacy_current_comparator: Report Candidate 1 versus preserved July-2026 legacy Fiscal score 52.539556447652046 / NEUTRAL, but do not retune to force a match.
fixed_initial_gates.usefulness: A separate usefulness gate must be frozen before any asset-return test. Candidate 1 cannot be promoted from construction or sanity checks alone.

historical_data_semantics.research_backtest: Current/revised FRED history with conservative publication-lag rules; it is not represented as exact point-in-time historical releases.
historical_data_semantics.prospective_production_path: Future promotion requires raw prospective bytes/hashes and fail-closed date/source/contract checks from the existing fiscal-prospective archive.

guardrails: Fiscal remains an OVERLAY/conviction modifier and cannot overwrite Money Core.
Funding V2 is unchanged and remains a separate bounded OVERLAY.
The legacy July-2026 Fiscal baseline remains historical production reference until a new version passes explicit promotion guards.
Do not change sources, weights, z-score window, publication lags or regime thresholds after seeing empirical results; a materially better construction requires Candidate 2.
Do not treat current revised FRED history as exact historical release-time data.
Do not add debt, interest, receipts or expenditures to the score merely because they improve a backtest; they are diagnostics in Candidate 1.
